title: Finite multi-generation exact-S0 closure cannot realize arbitrary fresh structure-sensitive output
semanticClaim: A finite exact-only S0 machine whose every generation preserves the closure {opaque input identity} union fixed exact support remains inside that closure for any finite number of generations.
Therefore a required structure-sensitive result that differs from the opaque input and is not pre-authored in fixed exact support is unreachable under that execution boundary.
This closes the loophole that repeated pure exact-identity reactions could recover generic fresh structural transformation without any structure-sensitive observation/construction capability.
explicitPremises: Fixed finite exact support contains every pre-authored exact consequence available to the S0 machine.
The opaque whole current input identity may be preserved.
Every S0 generation preserves closure: emitted Links are only the opaque input identity or members of fixed exact support.
No structural START/END reflection or decomposition is available inside S0.
No fresh structural constructor can emit a Link outside the closure.
exclusions: This does not prove one particular S1/S2 API or implementation is uniquely necessary.
This does not require J1 cross-current-member join.
This does not claim the frozen A-memory implementation satisfies the exact-S0 closure law without separate refinement evidence.
This does not forbid preserving the opaque whole current Link identity.
